Complete Guide to CSS Neumorphism Generator

Neumorphism (Soft UI) is an influential design style that mimics physical plastic extrusions and depressions in a single continuous surface. By using twin light and dark shadows placed in opposition, neumorphic elements appear to extrude naturally out of the background.

TECHTIS CSS Neumorphism Generator provides complete control over the geometry of your Soft UI elements. You can select between extruded flat surfaces, curved concave and convex forms, or pressed inset toggle buttons. Precision sliders control distance, blur radius, curvature, and elevation.

The tool automatically derives mathematically harmonious light and shadow tints from your chosen base color, generating production-ready CSS with zero guesswork.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about CSS Neumorphism Generator and privacy

What is Neumorphism (Soft UI) in web design?
Neumorphism is a design style where UI elements appear extruded from or debossed into the background surface, created using paired highlights (white light shadows) and shadows (dark shadows) on matching background colors.
How to generate Neumorphic CSS code for free?
Open TECHTIS CSS Neumorphism Generator. Pick your background color, adjust the Light Source angle, size, blur radius, and shape (Flat, Concave, Convex, or Inset). Click 'Copy CSS' to paste the paired box-shadow code.
Why must the component background match the page background?
Neumorphism relies on the illusion of continuous physical material. The component background must match the container background color for the extruded effect to work.
How do I create a pressed/clicked button state in neumorphism?
Select the 'Inset' shape mode in our tool. It reverses the light and dark shadows to create a sunken, pressed button state.
Are my designs uploaded to any external server?
No! All shadow rendering and code generation execute strictly in local browser memory. Zero data leaves your device.
Can I adjust blur and shadow intensity for accessibility?
Yes! You can fine-tune shadow distance, blur radius, and intensity to maintain contrast standards.
Does TECHTIS charge for generating Neumorphic CSS?
No. TECHTIS is 100% free with unlimited usage.
Does this tool work completely offline?
Yes! Once loaded in your browser cache, the tool functions without an internet connection.
